(2) The scene cuts to a top-down close-up of his head, where numerous green, pink, and blue hair rollers are intricately placed and secured with white clips for a perming process. A female stylist in a grey top stands behind him, meticulously adjusting the rollers on his crown. The environment is clean and modern with bright indoor lighting. (4) Transition to a close-up of the final result: voluminous, wavy dark hair with highly defined curls. The man looks directly into the camera, turning his head slowly from side to side to showcase the curls and the newfound texture of his hair. The man touches his hair and looks at the camera with a satisfied and confident expression. (6) The final phase shows the man outdoors in an urban street setting during the day. He wears a grey scarf and holds a white takeaway coffee cup, taking a sip while looking thoughtfully off-camera. The background features yellow taxis, urban traffic, and several pedestrians walking along the sidewalk.
